questions.q: What is the difference between the Simple Present and the Present Progressive Tense?
questions.a: Simple Present rutin/alışkanlıkları anlatır (I go to school every day); Present Progressive şu anda olan eylemleri anlatır (I am going to school now).

questions.q: How are adverbs of frequency used (always, usually, often, sometimes, never)?
questions.a: Sıklık zarfları bir eylemin ne sıklıkla yapıldığını gösterir ve genellikle ana fiilden önce, 'be' fiilinden sonra kullanılır.

questions.q: Give examples of polite requests with 'can, could, may, might'.
questions.a: Could you open the window, please? / May I come in? / Can I borrow your pen? — Kibar rica kalıplarıdır.

questions.q: What are question tags in present tenses?
questions.a: Cümle sonuna eklenen kısa soru ekleridir: 'You are a student, aren't you?' veya 'He doesn't like maths, does he?'

questions.q: Name three kinds of school events or celebrations.
questions.a: School trips, sports day, national days (e.g. 23 Nisan), graduation ceremonies, festivals.

questions.q: Name common classroom objects in English.
questions.a: Board, desk, chair, book, notebook, pencil, eraser, ruler, backpack, projector.

questions.q: Give examples of classroom instructions.
questions.a: Open your books, please. / Listen carefully. / Work in pairs. / Raise your hand.

questions.q: How do prepositions of place describe position in the classroom?
questions.a: In, on, under, next to, behind, in front of, between — nesnelerin yerini belirtir (e.g. The book is on the desk).

questions.q: What phrases are used to ask for and give permission?
questions.a: May I go out? / Can I ask a question? — Sure, go ahead. / Of course.

units.name: Theme 3 - Personal Life: Physical Appearance & Personality

questions.q: How do we describe physical appearance in English?
questions.a: Using adjectives: tall, short, slim, plump, curly/straight hair, blue eyes, and structures like 'She has got long hair'.

questions.q: How do we describe personality?
questions.a: With adjectives: kind, helpful, shy, outgoing, generous, hardworking, patient — 'He is very generous'.

questions.q: What is the difference between 'have got' and 'has got'?
questions.a: 'Have got' I/you/we/they ile, 'has got' he/she/it ile kullanılır; sahiplik ve özellik belirtir.

questions.q: Name five family members in English.
questions.a: Mother, father, sister, brother, grandmother, grandfather, aunt, uncle, cousin.

questions.q: How is the possessive ('s / of) used?
questions.a: Sahiplik belirtir: 'My mother's name is Ayşe.' / 'the father of my friend'.

questions.q: Describe a typical family routine using the Simple Present.
questions.a: My father goes to work at eight. We have dinner together at seven in the evening. I do my homework after dinner.

units.name: Theme 5 - Life in the House & Neighbourhood

questions.q: Name the rooms of a house.
questions.a: Living room, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, study/office, garden, balcony.

questions.q: How is 'there is / there are' used?
questions.a: Tekil için 'there is' (There is a sofa), çoğul için 'there are' (There are two windows) kullanılır.

questions.q: What places are there in a neighbourhood?
questions.a: Bakery, pharmacy, supermarket, bank, park, hospital, school, post office.

units.name: Theme 6 - Life in the City & Country

questions.q: How do we ask for and give directions?
questions.a: How can I get to the museum? Turn left, go straight, then turn right — Yol sorma ve tarif kalıplarıdır.

questions.q: How is the comparative form of adjectives used?
questions.a: İki şeyi karşılaştırır: bigger, smaller, more crowded. 'The city is more crowded than the village.'

questions.q: Compare life in the city and the country.
questions.a: City life is busier and more crowded; country life is quieter and calmer.

units.name: Theme 7 - Life in the World & Nature

questions.q: Name some natural elements and weather conditions.
questions.a: Mountain, river, forest, sea, sun, rain, snow, wind, fog.

questions.q: How can we talk about protecting the environment?
questions.a: We should recycle, save water, and plant trees. We shouldn't litter or waste energy.

questions.q: What modals express obligation and advice about nature?
questions.a: Must/should for obligation and advice (We must protect animals; We should save water).

units.name: Theme 8 - Life in the Universe & Future

questions.q: How do we talk about the future in English?
questions.a: Will ve be going to yapıları kullanılır: 'I will be a doctor.' / 'She is going to visit space.'

questions.q: Name some space-related words.
questions.a: Universe, planet, star, galaxy, astronaut, spaceship, satellite, moon.

questions.q: What is the difference between 'will' and 'be going to'?
questions.a: 'Will' anlık karar/tahmin, 'be going to' önceden planlanan niyet için kullanılır.
